groups.description: Finite named as-entry choices and ability/static gating
groups.required_change: EntryChoiceValue/Kind currently offer card-name/color/basic-type/creature-type/parity, not the printed clan choices; need exact-incarnation chosen value, public observation, copy-no-choice behavior and chosen static/trigger gates.

groups.description: Correct Endure controller, legal choice and last-known controller
groups.required_change: Confirmed defect: Instruction::Endure and Pending::Endure assign player=item.controller; CR701.63a uses permanent current controller/LKI. Also forbid choosing counters where counters_prohibited. Preserve branch/restore and replacements.

groups.description: Optional milled-card recovery with if-you-do-not continuation
groups.required_change: RecoverMilled can choose/recover exact mill result but neither decline nor successful selection branches the following program. Need selected/actual recovery outcome with printed If-you-dont semantics, no resurrection across new incarnation.

groups.description: Combat-plus-main insertion and source-independent attack callbacks
groups.required_change: AdditionalCombatsAfterCurrentMain inserts consecutive combats then old successor; it does not insert a main after EACH additional combat. No source-independent one-shot/repeated nonempty declaration callback until cleanup. Need proper ordering and multiplicity, exact end-step token sacrifice reuse.

groups.description: Greatest controlled toughness and sampled variable copiable token P/T
groups.required_change: No StatValue/AmountValue GreatestCreatureToughness (only StepValue total and spell-cost greatest), and no generic variable base Spirit token creation. Token must have sampled copiable X/X, not counters/temporary layer effect.

groups.description: Sequential top exile until first nonland with immediate optional free cast and fallback hand
groups.required_change: Existing ExileDamagedLibraryUntilNonland targets damage player and does not provide this exact self-library cast+chosen-spell MV8+fallback hand continuation. Implement typed owned effect using existing cast machinery; lands stay exiled and no later free permission.

groups.description: Per-color nontarget choices and distinct successful recipient win
groups.required_change: Need five mandatory-if-possible WUBRG Dragon choices, not target announcements; same Dragon may receive multiple counters but win requires5 distinct exact recipients actually receiving counters. Counter replacements/prohibitions and win restriction matter.

groups.description: Optional behold additional-cost choice and captured cast qualification
groups.required_change: Mandatory Behold OR mana cost is supported (Caustic uses FRA Countersculpt pattern); optional behold has no historical paid flag/branch usable in resolution/copies. Record exact successful cast qualification and avoid tying it to current Dragon presence.

groups.description: Global typed permanent-kind activation prohibition
groups.required_change: activation_prohibited currently handles source-linked until-untap and opponent-turn cast restrictions; lacks all-players artifact|creature|planeswalker permanent activation lock including mana. Extend actual and speculative characteristic queries, no zone leakage.

groups.description: Subtype-filtered free alternative cost across otherwise permitted zones
groups.required_change: FreeHandCast is hand-only/unfiltered; need Dragon-filtered free alternative in every otherwise authorized cast origin, preserving additional costs, X0 and prohibition on alternative-cost stacking. XMage fromHand=false confirms intended all-permitted-zone behavior.

groups.description: Target-subtype spell cost increase
groups.required_change: TargetCostReduction supports fixed discounts only; need generic+2 when the selected live target has Dragon at cost determination, integrated with guided target and funding paths and additional/free costs.

groups.description: Target color-count activation reduction
groups.required_change: activation_target_reductions are fixed discounts for matching target rules; counter/subtype discounts do not encode distinct target colors. Need live target colors count, including0 and5, actual/speculative identical.

groups.description: Hexproof from monocolored for equipped creature
groups.required_change: SourceCharacteristicFilter currently Color/Instant only; QualifiedHexproof self provider cannot directly grant equipment-recipient monocolored condition. Add typed qualified attachment protection in ability layers and spell/ability source color query.

groups.description: Live any-counter controlled-creature predicate
groups.required_change: SourceTotalCounters exists but CountFilter cannot express another creature with any kind of counter. Need scalar/predicate querying all hot+named counters and effective current creature/control, in actual/speculative worlds and threshold/intervening-if.

groups.description: Exact delayed graveyard departure qualified by departure controller, irrespective of current creature type
groups.required_change: DiesOnce currently requires event.before.is_creature() and has no departure-controller filter. Official notes require draw even if target no longer creature when it enters graveyard, only under original spell controller. Add separate typed event rather than weakening all DiesOnce consumers.

groups.description: Untapped-subtype recipients of hexproof grant
groups.required_change: KeywordGrant CreatureFilter has relation/token/subtype/attacking but no tapped predicate; LiveStaticEffect conditions do not gate recipient tap status. Need live layer6 recipient qualification compatible with speculative tap payments.

groups.description: Fixed subtype entry counters from prior provider
groups.required_change: OtherSubtypeEntryCounters adds COUNT of existing subtype permanents, not fixed1; OtherControlledEntryCountersByManaValue excludes source and filters by kind/MV not subtype. Need fixed controlled-Dragon entrant bonus, no application from provider entering simultaneously; complete copy/type actual and virtual handling.

groups.description: Activation guard conjunction of own turn and graveyard departure history
groups.required_change: ActivationGuard has OwnTurn but not arbitrary expressions/conjunction or CardLeftGraveyardThisTurn; existing StatValue history should be reused. Guard must affect legal actions and funding, not merely skip effect at resolution.

groups.description: One-shot next arbitrary-spell copy callback
groups.required_change: CopyNextInstantSorcery skips permanent casts; CopySpellsThisTurn observes arbitrary spells repeatedly. Extend callback population/consumption for one next cast any type with independent captured packet, retain existing complete permanent-spell copy semantics and no token-creation doubling.

groups.description: Graveyard-zone creature-death observer registration
groups.required_change: register_graveyard_sources only registers AtStep and PlayerDamaged; no CreatureDies death index registration. Need frozen pre-event graveyard observers, correct owner as ability controller, source in graveyard BEFORE deaths and exact captured return binding.

groups.description: Optional one-card discard and nonland reflexive followup
groups.required_change: DiscardTwoNonlandReflexive hardcodes mandatory2, whereas Glacial must first draw then OPTIONAL1 and queue only for actual nonland discard. Generic ChooseObjects Discard optional lacks a chosen-card-type conditional/DiscardAfter handoff. Reuse owned discard contexts with typed amount/optional reflexive parameters.

groups.description: entry modes
groups.required_change: Extend owned as-enters choices with a bounded named mode, and gate whole triggered/static/activated printed lines on its exact incarnation. No choice on an in-place copy means neither mode. Copying/entry replacements and rollback must preserve this boundary.
groups.status: confirmed missing typed value and conditional providers

groups.description: counter on own creature
groups.required_change: Add placement trigger qualifying recipient current/pre-entry controller and creature characteristics regardless of placing player, across every counter kind. Existing CounterPlacedByYou variants qualify placer and do not implement Hollowmurk. Apply OncePerTurn at queue time; entry counters qualify.

groups.description: death counter snapshot
groups.required_change: Add a death observer matching any controlled creature with counters, freezing the whole per-kind counter multiset from its pre-death ObjectView onto each packet. Copy this snapshot to legal recipients on resolution; never read observer counters, live graveyard object counters, or a later incarnation. Include simultaneous self/other deaths and negative counters before +1/-1 annihilation.
groups.status: confirmed missing captured other-object counter payload

groups.description: counter kind union
groups.required_change: Add distinct positive counter-kind union over currently controlled creatures, using borrowed actual and speculative characteristic worlds. Count duplicate kinds once, exclude noncreatures/opponent creatures and zero counts. Source-local count or sum of per-object cardinalities is wrong.

groups.description: graveyard entry counter
groups.required_change: Reuse SelfGraveyardCastIf for normal paid self permission; add graveyard-cast-only exact-entry counter qualification. Existing cast_entry_counters applies any cast and hand_cast_entry_counters applies only hand. A countered spell must return graveyard rather than flashback exile. Existing Finality death replacement remains authoritative after ability loss.
groups.status: confirmed missing origin-qualified entry counter metadata

groups.description: any damage incarnation
groups.required_change: Add/read actual positive damage dealt across the exact permanent incarnation (combat OR noncombat), surviving turns and control/copy changes but clearing on a true zone change. Expose through actual/speculative earlier-layer stat query for conditional hexproof. Update history before damage-trigger target acquisition.

groups.description: mana spell filter
groups.required_change: Generalize immutable produced-mana restrictions to creature spells and union spell predicates Dragon OR Omen, evaluating the selected spell face in actual/speculative funding. Existing SpellSubtype is single-subtype only; do not mark all Dragon-card faces as Dragons. Retain ordinary restrictions for extra costs and cannot fund unrelated activation/ward payments.

groups.description: variable endure
groups.required_change: Extend Endure to an AmountValue and explicit subject, choosing exactly one dynamic white N/N Spirit or N +1 counters, including N0 no action. Reuse owned Pending and counter/token replacement pipeline; never require one pre-generated token card for every X. Preserve choice/recipe in raw/index branch and snapshot/restore.

groups.description: activation x life
groups.required_change: Add real X life payment for declared activation X alongside generic X mana, colored mana, tap and other costs. Current life_x_cost branch only handles StackKind::Spell; ActivationCost.life is fixed u16. Funding/legal X intervals and life-payment replacements must consider all cost components and restore failed attempts atomically.

groups.description: dynamic exact optional mill
groups.required_change: Generalize existing MayMill exact-feasibility guard and MillAmount to controlled-land-count amount sampled on resolution. The choice to mill N must be unavailable when fewer than N library cards remain. Fixed MayMill3 already covers Rainveil without new machinery.

groups.description: graveyard power damage
groups.required_change: Freeze a legal own graveyard creature target current power, including CDAs, for subsequent spell-source damage to an independent creature target after return-to-hand. Current AmountValue::TargetCreaturePower capture is wired only for specific Amass consumers and selected group, not this graveyard group. CR608.2b: illegal graveyard target cannot supply power and causes no damage, while an illegal battlefield target does not prevent returning the legal card.

groups.description: distinct color search
groups.required_change: Add color search predicates and a single private library search with independent distinct B/G/U slots. A multicolor card can fill one role while permitting other multicolor cards in other roles; fail-to-find any subset0..3 legal. Freeze group and move simultaneously to graveyard then shuffle once; enforce search restrictions and privacy.

groups.description: search result entry counters
groups.required_change: Extend searched-result entry operation to carry fixed/mixed counters before replacement/ETB commit. Magmatic Hellkite additionally freezes destroyed land controller before attempt, searches despite indestructibility, and searches only if target still legal. Do not add counter after entering or gate search on actual destruction.
groups.status: confirmed missing counter payload on search entry

groups.description: linked exile attacking copies
groups.required_change: Copy exact still-linked physical exile card recipe, create tapped token per opponent attacking that opponent, and register exact results for the controller next end step (not whichever player next has end step). Handle source gone before ETB, tokens ceasing, copied noncreature physical cards, blink/rebind and departure-trigger LKI.

groups.description: mass in place copy

EntryCopySpec optional any creature already covers Naga entry; do not add another entry-copy subsystem.

groups.description: discard hand cost

Do not demand actual discarded-card count>0.
